title: Vue stories vs React stories on points
question: Does a story about Vue get more points than a story about React?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about Vue gets more points than a story about React.
expect: If true, points per story for Vue stories should be at least 1.5x the value for React stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, Vue against React

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h317 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h317 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
